brief:
Gaza held a funeral procession for fifty bodies exhumed from beneath the rubble, the Ma'an news agency reported. The remains were recovered from collapsed structures across the territory.

The mass burial underscored the scale of destruction in Gaza, where extensive damage to buildings and infrastructure has left large numbers of bodies trapped beneath debris. Recovery operations have continued as families seek to locate and bury their dead.
title: Gaza buries fifty bodies recovered from rubble
